title: Fixed Open Side Wedge Socket and Returned Cord
description: One newly authored complete open-side tapered wedge-socket and returned-cord illustrative display. A thick tapered C-section socket has a full rear wall, broad closed end, narrow true end mouth and intentionally open front. One entire rounded-head tapered wedge lies inside; one continuous round cord makes a full U return around it and exits as two unequal straight tails. A real pierced terminal eye and whole root connect to the broad socket end. Two short feet and a low base support the horizontal cutaway display. Unlike the long-window double-eye turnbuckle there are no opposed threaded rods, and unlike the ratchet strap there are no drum, pawl, toothed disks, operating lever, hook ends or broad webbing. All geometry newly authored; no old clamp or rope component extracted. Nine closed editable meshes with three opaque constant PBR roles, metres native Z up and horizontal whole-envelope centre over a finite base sole, one prop zero scenes. Fixed artistic cutaway only, with deliberate slight fixed cord-to-wedge and wedge-to-backing seating: not a real cable termination design or threading/installation instruction. No grip, friction, tensioning, cable compatibility, retention, movement, load transmission, lifting, anchoring, manufacture, rigging or equipment safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made or verified.
